circular.title: Harmonisation of Turn Around Time (TAT) and customer compensation for failed transactions using authorised payment systems

rules.label: ATM cash not dispensed or partially dispensed
rules.user_prompt: I tried to withdraw cash at an ATM but the money did not dispense though my account was debited
rules.circular_row: ATM: cash not dispensed / partially dispensed

rules.label: Card to card transfer amount debited but not credited to recipient
rules.user_prompt: I transferred money card-to-card and it was debited from my account but the beneficiary did not receive it
rules.circular_row: Card to Card transfer: card account not credited

rules.label: Card payment at shop/POS debited but merchant did not receive payment
rules.user_prompt: I swiped or tapped my card at a shop counter, the money was debited but the merchant terminal did not confirm payment
rules.circular_row: POS / Merchant: account debited but confirmation not received

rules.label: Online card payment debited but website/app did not confirm
rules.user_prompt: I made an online card payment on a website or app, money was debited but the transaction failed or gave no confirmation
rules.circular_row: Card Not Present (e-commerce): account debited but confirmation not received

rules.label: IMPS transfer debited but recipient did not get it
rules.user_prompt: I sent money via IMPS, money was deducted from my account but the receiver did not receive it
rules.circular_row: IMPS: account debited but beneficiary not credited

rules.label: UPI payment to a person did not arrive
rules.user_prompt: I sent money by UPI and the receiver did not get it

rules.label: UPI payment to a merchant debited but transaction failed
rules.user_prompt: I scanned a QR or paid a merchant using UPI, money was deducted but merchant did not receive payment
rules.circular_row: UPI: account debited but confirmation not received at merchant

rules.label: AePS merchant transaction debited but confirmation not received
rules.user_prompt: I made an Aadhaar-enabled payment (AePS) at a merchant or business correspondent, money was debited but transaction failed
rules.circular_row: AePS: account debited but confirmation not received at merchant

rules.label: AePS cash withdrawal or transfer failed but debited
rules.user_prompt: I attempted an AePS transaction other than merchant payment, my account was debited but money was not received

rules.label: Aadhaar Payment Bridge System (APBS) credit delayed
rules.user_prompt: Government subsidy or benefit through Aadhaar Payment Bridge was debited or delayed and not credited to my bank account
rules.circular_row: APBS: delay in crediting beneficiary account

rules.label: NACH credit transaction delayed in reaching customer account
rules.user_prompt: A salary, dividend or direct credit via NACH was delayed and not credited on time to my bank account
rules.circular_row: NACH: delay in crediting beneficiary account

rules.label: NACH auto-debit executed after mandate revocation
rules.user_prompt: My account was auto-debited via NACH even after I officially revoked or cancelled the mandate
rules.circular_row: NACH: account debited after mandate revocation

rules.label: Prepaid wallet / card (on-us) debited but not credited
rules.user_prompt: I reloaded or paid money from my prepaid wallet/card within the same issuer and the amount was debited but not credited
rules.circular_row: Prepaid Payment Instruments: on-us transaction not credited
